algebra.convention: Operators compose right to left. Q and T are fixed common preparation/presentation; only C and N swap positions.

operators.Q: Paint dot and outline scaffolding with fill/stroke none in both runs.
operators.C: Use native byIndex color mapping on circle.multi-ring,line[data-spline-lines-run], assigning exactly five cyclic stroke colors to the current selected element order. Identical config in both runs.
operators.N: Replace every circle.multi-ring with the identical 22-point, four-step-per-segment normal-line spline operator. Generated segments inherit the parent membrane color until a later color operator overwrites each segment.
operators.T: The identical mild affine transform completes both experiments.

controlledVariables: Native app, source, seed, frame count, canvas size, background, complete params, Q, C, N, T are identical.
Only the positions of C and N differ.
algebra.prediction: N after C produces uniformly colored normal bundles per original halo. C after N cycles the five-color palette through individual new normal segments. The geometric line coordinates and counts should match; stroke assignment should differ.
algebra.verification: Compare geometry signatures excluding styling and run-specific data attributes, then compare computed stroke colors or preview hashes. Different PNG hashes alone establish visual difference, not equal geometry.
